body.x: BorgWarner Chungju Co Ltd (CEO KuiSeon Park) participated in the “2024 Future Innovation tech eXpo (FIX 2024)” held from October 23 (Wed) to October 26 (Sat) at Daegu EXCO.

BorgWarner, a global leader with over 130 years of experience, is known for supplying OEM parts to major automotive manufacturers. With engine and transmission technology expertise, the company has recently focused on developing motor and thermal management technologies for eco-friendly vehicles such as electric cars.
BorgWarner Chungju’s sales were approximately 69 billion KRW last year, aiming to reach 72 billion KRW in 2024.

At this exhibition, BorgWarner plans to highlight its high-quality component technology to industry professionals and the general public to raise brand awareness and share its contributions to eco-friendly automotive technology advancements. The company is committed to developing more efficient technology through future client collaborations.

Key products include the latest electric vehicle technology, integrated motor inverters and transmission power transfer systems, advanced battery thermal management control technology, film-thick heating elements, and silicon-based inverters.

FIX 2024 featured specialized exhibitions, conferences, and business programs focusing on mobility, robotics, AI, and startups. The Daegu International Future Auto & Mobility Expo 2024 at EXCO’s East Wing showcased trends in UAM, autonomous driving, batteries, components, and services. Meanwhile, the 2024 ICT Convergence Expo Korea, held in the West Wing, exhibited AI, big data, blockchain, ICT, and metaverse technologies. The 2024 Daegu Robot Expo displayed industrial robots, humanoid robots, and digital transformation solutions for the robotics industry. The “Startup Arena” was introduced to facilitate meetings between startups and experts from startup accelerators like Samsung C-Lab and Plug and Play.
